name: 80121 · Centennial, CO
findings: ZIP 80121 (Centennial) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80121 (Centennial) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
